title: Plan: native DeepSeek4 expert_used_count=4 override probe
purpose: Test a no-download behavior-changing route inspired by the 4Expert artifact: override the native model's expert_used_count from 6 to 4 to reduce active MoE expert work, while preserving all strict correctness/RAM/TTFT gates.

hypothesis.positive: Reducing n_expert_used from 6 to 4 should reduce selected gate/up/down expert work and source pressure by roughly one third in the MoE path, potentially producing a larger token-rate jump than cache-prefill tweaks.
hypothesis.negative: The native model was trained/configured for 6 selected experts. A simple metadata override is not equivalent to the external 4Expert model because it lacks ffn_gate_tid2eid.weight routing constraints and Q4_K expert quantization. Accuracy may degrade even if France remains superficially fluent.

hard_bound.comment: Even a perfect one-third reduction of active-expert-specific work is unlikely to reach 10 tok/s alone because non-MoE and source/page buckets remain, but it is the largest no-download current-route probe left and can clarify the practical correctness/performance bound.

accepted_if: France answer is semantic, coherent, and factually acceptable
full reproduction metadata is recorded and pushed immediately
rejected_if: France answer is incoherent, semantically wrong, or visibly degraded

notes: This probe cannot be treated as equivalent to cloudyu 4Expert GGUF.
If it passes France, a five-prompt semantic gate should be run before using it as a general route.
If it fails correctness or reproduction, do not continue native top-k overrides.
